description: Renders a public web page in a real headless browser (JavaScript runs, redirects are followed) and returns it as clean markdown, a PNG screenshot or a PDF. One call, one payment, no account. A render that fails is not charged. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC (x402).

format.description: markdown: the page's main content as text. screenshot: a PNG image. pdf: a PDF document.

fullPage.description: screenshot: capture the whole page, up to 8000px tall.

selector.description: CSS selector. markdown: convert only that element. screenshot: capture only that element.

url.description: Public http(s) page to render. Private, local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused.

waitForSelector.description: Wait until this CSS selector exists before capturing.

waitUntil.description: When the page counts as loaded, default networkidle2.

name: render_page
title: Render a web page
